svg.title: Revision B proposed two-load circuit schematic
svg.desc: Eight module symbols and named nets show all 28 connections. Separate USB logic and qualified bench load supply. Not battery wiring. Original 60-wire diagram is a separate design.
svg.text: PROPOSED — NOT BATTERY WIRING — NO HARDWARE QUALIFICATION
Conventional module symbols. Equal net names connect electrically; positions are logical, not physical.
Each endpoint lists its B record(s). The index below preserves all 28 proposed connections and their gates.
EXTERNAL CONNECTIONS · SOURCE AND WIRING GATES REMAIN OPEN
USB only → controller; no header input power
One physical junction; review USB/scope/earth paths
3V3 / SDA / SCL: logic only. G0: shared reference. 12V_BENCH: load input. M_SUP / L_SUP: after shunts.
M_SW / L_SW: switched load returns, not GND. V+ and output + join inside each driver. Shunt terminals do not short.
Load connections stay gated until source, wiring, current limits, flyback and measurement setup are reviewed.
Read docs/hardware-build-proposal.md for exact parts, measurement boundaries and commissioning gates.
The inherited 60-wire circuit is a separate design. Do not combine wiring instructions.
